a.xlink:title: Backend-agnostic GPU buffer: vertex, index, constant, or resource view target.
D3D11 buffer wrapper covering vertex/index/constant usages and custom configurations.
D3D12 buffer wrapper: default-heap resource plus an upload heap for CPU-to-GPU copies.
OpenGL VBO/EBO/UBO wrapper; target is derived from BufferType at construction.
VMA-backed Vulkan buffer with staging uploads, batched copies, and a size-bucketed recycling pool.
Common lifecycle contract for GPU-backed resources: init, per-frame update, teardown.
